text:
alisa: Quick heads-up — FP8 kernel enablement for orion20b on an H100 + L40S canary just tripped a precision safety gate. Canary shows a quality regression on long prefixes (~2k tokens). Bisect help?
mira: ugh. can you share the canary run id and the exact variant (AWQ/GPTQ + quant bits)?
alisa: run id: canary-2026-03-20-09, variant: AWQ-int8-adaptive -> but we enabled fp8-kernel path (mixed-precision handshake) on H100 with L40S drivers. baseline eval-suite-v2 perplexity 12.1 -> canary 12.55 (+3.7%).
pat: logs attached from the canary node (short):

```
[2026-03-20 09:12:03] kernel: selected fp8_gemm_v2
[2026-03-20 09:12:03] kv_cache: handshake mode=auto
[2026-03-20 09:12:08] warning: kv-evict triggered at step 1800
[2026-03-20 09:12:09] fallback: switched to fp16 slow-path for block 3
```

pat: note the kv-evict and immediate fallback — that could change prefix caching behavior and cause distribution shift on long context.
raj: interesting — AWQ vs GPTQ tends to interact differently with the fp8 kernels because of per-channel scale artifacts. Did we enable per-channel quant scaling? also which compiler flags for kernels?
alisa: we used fp8_per_channel_scale=true and kernel-flags: "--tile=32 --vectorize" (default). GPU driver: l40s-510.42. canary-bot posted the alert: ":rotating_light: canary quality delta 3.7% (threshold 2.0%)"
canary-bot: canary-2026-03-20-09: ALERT quality-regression: delta=3.7% threshold=2.0 routes=[hosted-delta, h100-l40s-canary]
jen: quick reproducer jobs to run locally:
- repro-small: python scripts/repro_longprefix.py --model orion20b --quant awq --prefix-len 2048 --use-fp8
- repro-ablate: same but toggle --fp8-per-channel false

raj: also try disabling kv-evict with `--kv-evict-threshold=0.99` or force `--kv-mode=sticky` — if eviction is the trigger then handshake will flip execution path.
alisa: trying reproducer now. attaching sample prompt + diff of top tokens (short):

Prompt: "In the year 2077, the first colony on Titan reported..."

Baseline top-1: "reported" (0.18)
Canary top-1: "declared" (0.15)  <-- subtle semantic drift

mira: small lexicon shift but consistent across many prompts? that's worrying for downstream UX.
pat: ran repro-ablate; with per-channel scaling off the delta drops to +0.9% (below threshold). so scale quantization paramization seems implicated.
jen: possible hypotheses:
1) fp8 per-channel scale interacts with AWQ scales causing under/overflow in GEMM microkernels for long-prefix accumulation
2) kv-evict -> handshake path switches precision mid-sequence causing inconsistent KV cache values

raj: suggestion: bisect on two axes in parallel: (A) per-channel scaling on/off, (B) kv-evict on/off. run matrix 2x2 on a small set (10 seeds) and measure perplexity + topk overlap.
alisa: starting matrix run now on a shadow canary pool. ETA ~ 45m. logs will be posted to S3: s3://redwood-canaries/canary-2026-03-20-09/matrix-

pat: quick hotfix idea to stop user impact: pause fp8 rollout for H100 + L40S and set safety_gate=fail-close (no rollout) until we finish bisect. someone from infra to flip config?
mira: I can toggle rollout flags. pausing now.
mira: pause applied to pool h100-l40s-canary (rollout_state=paused). ack :white_check_mark:
alisa: thanks. once matrix finishes we'll decide between (1) adjust per-channel scaling to a conservative clip, (2) change kv-evict heuristics, or (3) revert kernel selection for long-prefix workloads.
raj: add a quick smoke that forces sequence > 2k during CI to catch this in future.
jen: noted — will add smoke test and a metric in the canary dashboard: long-prefix-topk-overlap.
canary-bot: canary-2026-03-20-09: MATRIX job started id=matrix-317; results will stream to #eng-ml in thread.
alisa: assigning follow-ups: alisa -> bisect coord, pat -> collect detailed perf traces, raj -> kernel microbench, jen -> dashboard + smoke. thanks all :pray:
pat: quick patch snippet if we want conservative per-channel clipping (hotfix):

```
model.quant_config.fp8.per_channel_clipping = 6.0  # was 8.0
runtime.flags.fp8.handshake_threshold = 0.75  # reduce handshake aggressiveness
```

mira: capturing notes in ticket INF-2711. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2711

alisa: OK closing thread for now, will post matrix results in ~45m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
